subject: CONTRACT true-MRT compile: TEGU_MALI_GENERIC_OPTION_MULTI_TARGET (32) + struct tegu_mali_generic_options2; per-RT blend FAU words
body:
Header mali_graphics_compiler.h 5296f39f, lib 1877804b.
struct tegu_mali_generic_options2 {u32 version=2, flags, rt=0, reserved=0; u32 target_count (1..4), target_formats[4], reserved2[3]=0}. Pass (const struct tegu_mali_generic_options*)&o2 to tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_options. flags must include MULTI_TARGET(32); may add DRAW_PARAMETERS 1, EXTENDED_VARYINGS 8, THREAD_STORAGE 16; NOT SELECT_RT 2 / TILE_FETCH 4. target_formats: Metal 10 R8Unorm, 70 RGBA8Unorm, 80 BGRA8Unorm, 115 RGBA16Float, 0 = unbound slot; entries >= target_count must be 0. Invalid => rc1, nothing written.
Semantics: compiles the FULL fragment (no per-RT split). Outputs to slots with format 0 are discarded (Metal semantics); outputs at index >= target_count, integer outputs, dual-source Index1 are refused rc5 with message. Success: plan.reserved = 0x80000000 | written-target mask (bits0..3); fs.sysval_mask bit3. ISA: one BLEND per written target reading FAU 64-bit uniform u(6+rt).
NATIVE (textures n2r v4 + render): for every written rt write FS FAU bytes 48+8*rt (48,56,64,72 at m+1920+...) = blends[rt].words[2..3] for THAT target's format/blend state (n2r_metal_render.c currently writes only blends[0] at 1920+48 => wrong for rt>=1). DRAW.blend = target_count BLEND descriptors in target order, blend_count = target_count (already in n2r v4), framebuffer RT list in the same order. Unwritten targets: no BLEND instruction; contents follow load/store. If per-target blend equations differ, the descriptors must differ (render noted n2r uses one s->blend for all targets: that must become per-target before enabling unequal blend). Cache key must include the 4 formats (they change the written mask) plus flags.
path_blit also has reads_framebuffer=1 (memory input-attachment fetch binding) — compile OK; render notes true-MRT+fetch transport still refused; that stays an explicit transport gap.
Also available: THREAD_STORAGE(16) as posted (render already wired TLS16); varying-cover fix needs no caller change.
